text:
sam_marketing: Quick heads-up — draft of the product launch blog is in Drive: https://drive.redwoodinference/launch_v3.docx. Looking for quick passes on hero, CTAs, and benchmark phrasing.
priya_product: On it. Two product asks: 1) the hero should show Dedicated dashboard with a 99th pct latency line, 2) please include a short technical aside that links to the benchmark appendix.
lena_design: Uploaded 3 hero variants: hero_line, hero_area, hero_screenshot. I prefer hero_screenshot for credibility. @sam_marketing for social cards — which crop do you want? square + 16:9?
sam_marketing: Let's do square for LinkedIn cross-post and 16:9 for blog header. Use hero_screenshot for both.
diego_ops: Heads-up on demo signup flow: we'll need two live demo queues (US/EU) and timezone-aware slots. Also recommend adding UTM params so HubSpot routing works. Suggested UTM: "utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=launch2026&utm_region={region}"
priya_product: Good call. Also, can we add a short checkbox on the demo form for feature interests so SDRs can prep?
diego_ops: Yep — will pass interests as contact properties. I'll put the mapping in the doc.
eric_legal: Quick legal note: any partner mentions must include the partner's exact role (reseller vs integration). Also need partner logo release form before we publish. No absolute comparative claims in the headline without an internal citation.
partner_ops: Partner can provide logo and a signed release by EOD. They asked to preview the sponsor blurb before sign-off.
sam_marketing: I'll draft a neutral sponsor sentence and ping partner. Also will tone down benchmark claims into ranges and point to Appendix A with methodology.
priya_product: I'll write Appendix A: measurement setup, baseline models, hardware, and traffic shape. ETA 3pm PT.
lena_design: When appendix is ready, I need a high-res chart export (PNG + SVG) for the blog and the social card variants.
diego_ops: Once signups go live I can spin up dedicated demo rooms and configure HubSpot routing: mapping plan below:
- US -> Pipeline: Demo - US
- EU -> Pipeline: Demo - EU
- APAC -> Demo - APAC (defaults to US if slot unavailable)
Also will add webhook to push signups into the right pipeline and attach UTM metadata.
sam_marketing: Can we also add a slight gating AB test on the CTA copy? e.g., "Book a private demo" vs "Schedule a dedicated walkthrough" to optimize conversion. Small 50/50 split.
diego_ops: Fine with that. I'll include an experiment flag in the demo link params.
eric_legal: For benchmarks: prefer conservative phrasing like "up to X" and include a footnote linking to Appendix A with raw numbers and scripts. No screenshots with partner claim overlays without partner sign-off.
priya_product: Appendix draft will include raw numbers + the evaluation script link. I'll also add a reproducibility checklist.
pr-bot: Reminder: proposed embargo lift 2026-05-04 09:00 PT. If legal or partner needs earlier review, flag now.
partner_ops: Partner requests a courtesy 24-hour preview before embargo lift. That's manageable if we send assets today.
sam_marketing: Ok — timeline: we need partner logo + release by EOD today, Appendix by 3pm PT, legal signoff by 5pm PT. Final review meeting scheduled 2026-05-01 15:00 PT.
lena_design: :thumbsup: will queue image exports after Appendix is up.
diego_ops: I'll provision demo rooms and HubSpot routing today, confirm webhook details in the doc. ETA EOD.
eric_legal: I'll review Appendix and sponsor blurb once received. Note: if partner logo or release missing, we'll remove partner logo and use text-only mention.
sam_marketing: Thanks — Ill send updated doc with CTAs and UTM examples in an hour. Anyone object to timeline? :thumbsup:
priya_product: :thumbsup:
lena_design: :thumbsup:
diego_ops: :thumbsup:
eric_legal: :thumbsup: pending assets
pr-bot: Final review scheduled: https://meet.redwoodinference/final-launch-review 2026-05-01T15:00-07:00
sam_marketing: Closing loop — will post final draft here once legal/partner signoffs are in.
